li.label: water-disciplined
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was raised where every swallow of water is counted and every calorie has an owner. {PAWN_pronoun} needs less than other people, sleeps lightly and efficiently, and finds waste quietly offensive.

li.label: sand-stoic
li.description: The deep desert does not reward complaint. {PAWN_nameDef} treats pain as weather: noted, endured, and never discussed. It takes a great deal to make {PAWN_objective} stop walking, and more to make {PAWN_objective} break.

li.label: numbered
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} grew up as a designation, not a name. Insults slide off someone who was never quite a person to their superiors, and {PAWN_pronoun} almost never starts a fight — but warmth comes slowly, when it comes at all.

li.label: laconic
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} says what needs saying and not one word more. People who work by a code find most conversation to be noise, and most provocation to be somebody else's problem.

li.label: racer's reflexes
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has the reaction time of someone who has taken a repulsor sled through a canyon at speeds that should be fatal. {PAWN_pronoun} moves and dodges like a rumor — and has never once been accused of patience at a firing line.
